implementation_concepts: After mutating authoritative state, refresh or invalidate any dependent derived representation before it can serve later reads.
problem: An accepted authoritative-state mutation leaves a dependent read representation stale.

steps.instruction: Inspect the authoritative mutation and dependent read behavior.
Preserve validation, mutation return values, and existing public behavior.
Ensure an authoritative mutation leaves dependent derived state consistent for future reads.
Run the task test suite after modifying the implementation.
